summary: Created and verified `desk:apps:tally`; removed the temporary `desk:tally` test page, leaving no extra pages.

files.desk:apps:tally:
app 'Tally'
task start()
 set n to 0
 when exists('desk:tally')
  set n to number(read('desk:tally'))
 done
 give {n: n}
done
task key(s, k)
 when k is '+'
  set s.n to s.n + 1
 or when k is '-' and s.n > 0
  set s.n to s.n - 1
 or when k is 'r'
  set s.n to 0
 or when k is 'enter'
  write('desk:tally', s.n)
 done
 give s
done
task draw(s)
 show(1, 1, 'Count: ' & s.n)
done
